chunks.text:
[slide-1-title] (slide 1 · heading)
Halden Retail: store network review

[slide-1-b1] (slide 1 · paragraph)
Fictional case prepared for FilmDeck testing

[slide-2-title] (slide 2 · heading)
Store sales fell 6% while online sales grew 23%

[slide-2-b1] (slide 2 · list)
- Store sales are down 6% year on year
- Online sales are up 23% year on year
- Online now makes up 31% of total sales

[slide-2-notes] (slide 2 · speaker notes)
Online share crossed 30% for the first time.

[slide-3-title] (slide 3 · heading)
Rent is the largest fixed cost

[slide-3-b1] (slide 3 · table (first row = column headers))
Cost line | Share of costs | Change
Rent | 38% | +4%
Staff | 31% | +2%
Logistics | 14% | +9%

[slide-4-title] (slide 4 · heading)
Footfall is falling fastest in small stores

[slide-4-b1] (slide 4 · list)
- Small stores lost 14% of visits
- Large stores lost 5% of visits
- Customers still value local pickup

[slide-5-title] (slide 5 · heading)
Recommendation: close weak stores, grow pickup points

[slide-5-b1] (slide 5 · list)
- Close 12 of the weakest stores
- Open 40 pickup points near transit
- Reinvest the savings in delivery speed

[slide-5-notes] (slide 5 · speaker notes)
The closures are phased over two years.

[slide-6-title] (slide 6 · heading)
Next steps

[slide-6-b1] (slide 6 · list)
- Agree the closure list with the board
- Select pickup point sites
- Report progress each quarter
